info.name: Inthegame API Docs
info.description:
# Introduction
Documentation includes Docs for adminApi, userApi, socket listeners

# Overview
There was new user created specially for providing this Docs (api_tester). Each request has its endpoint on server side. adminApi requests execute while user changes admin panel state, userApi requests execute while user plays on app and manage his actions. Socket manages common engine functions like execution method every 1 min, getting messages from server actions to provide them on app. We created demo account api_tester/qwer1234 on admin panel https://admintest.inthegame.io/

# Authentication
In case of adminApi requests go with Authentication header token which saved in browser cookies. You can use your token which generated after login to https://admintest.inthegame.io/. For userApi request go with userToken parameter in request body

# Error Codes
200 - success
404, 500 - errors

# Rate limit
No
